summary: The diff stat supplied with this task (991 insertions across 6 files, including src/app/api/v1/projexa/module-chain/route.ts and route.test.ts) was computed against a stale merge-base (commit 4edfc273) rather than current origin/main (61b74cd5). I independently diffed this branch's HEAD against real current origin/main and found the module-chain route/test files, ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml, and ai-os/audits/projexa_erp_e2e_reaudit_2026-07-27.md are already byte-identical to what is on main today (merged separately, e.g. PR #609 for the module-chain route) -- so none of that content is actually new or duplicated by this merge. The genuine incremental diff this PR adds on top of current main is just two files: a 14-line append to PROGRESS.md and a new 339-line audit report, ai-os/audits/owner_engine_reaudit_2026-07-27.md, documenting an independent, verification-only re-audit of OWNER_ENGINE phases 4/5/8/9 (real file/test/tsc evidence quoted, honest INCOMPLETE verdicts recorded for phases 5 and 8 rather than rubber-stamping). This is pure documentation with no code, schema, auth, or security-path changes, no .github/workflows/** changes, and no functional risk since a merge would be a clean additive fast-forward against current main.
issues: Informational, non-blocking: the diff/file list handed to the reviewer for this task was stale (diffed against an old merge-base rather than current main), making the change look far larger and duplicative than it actually is. Future dispatch/review tooling should diff against the PR's actual current merge-base with origin/main to avoid this kind of misleading diff stat.
